subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should all workspace `.env` keys ending in `_ENDPOINT` be treated as untrusted routing controls, accepting that existing local endpoint overrides must migrate to trusted sources?
rationale: The code and proof support the broad rule, but only a security owner can authorize the intentional compatibility break at this protected trust boundary.
